defs.def: to start sth, such as an organization or an institution, especially by providing money 创建，创办（组织或机构，尤指提供资金）

ex.s: The research, carried out by scientists at the Columbia Climate School and other institutions, found that if the city maintains past species patterns in new plantings, isoprene production in Manhattan in coming decades will go up by about 140%, and resulting summer ozone levels as much as 30%.
ex.t: 这项由哥伦比亚气候学院及其他机构的科学家开展的研究发现，如果该市在新种植中沿用过去的树种模式，未来几十年曼哈顿的异戊二烯产量将上升约140%，由此导致的夏季臭氧水平最多将上升30%。

ex.s: She tried to call for help but found no signal on her phone.
ex.t: 她试图打电话求救，却发现手机没有信号。

ex.s: I found comfort in keeping myself awake when everyone else had gone to bed, and I loved the silence of the night.
ex.t: 用大写字母写的“安静”标志到处都是。如果她觉得你穿得不合适，她会直接让你回家换衣服。

ex.s: We found that those rated as more moral reported a stronger sense of well-being.
ex.t: 我们发现，那些被认为更有道德的人报告了更强的幸福感。

ex.s: More than once, I found myself wondering just how my students, who’d created these people, knew their subjects so well.
ex.t: 不止一次，我发现自己想知道，创造了这些角色的我的学生们，怎么会如此了解他们所写的人物。

ex.s: In a study published Wednesday in Environmental Science & Technology Letters, researchers from China found that boiling tap water for just five minutes — then filtering it after it cools — could remove at least 80 percent of its microplastics.
ex.t: 在周三发表于《Environmental Science & Technology Letters》的一项研究中，中国研究人员发现，将自来水煮沸仅五分钟——冷却后过滤——可去除其中至少80%的微塑料。

ex.s: The team focused only on three common types — polystyrene, polyethylene and polypropylene — and they didn’t study other chemicals previously found in water such as vinyl chloride.
ex.t: 该团队只关注三种常见类型——聚苯乙烯、聚乙烯和聚丙烯——他们没有研究之前在水中发现的其他化学物质，如氯乙烯。

ex.s: However, I soon found that by doing so, I might be losing something more important: the opportunity to share a small part of my cultural identity.
ex.t: 然而我很快发现，这样做我可能正在失去更重要的东西：分享自己文化身份一小部分的机会。

ex.s: In her study, Martin asked participants to rate their attachment to male, female, and genderless versions of a digital voice assistant and a self-driving car known as “Miuu.” It was found that gender increased users’ feelings of attachment to these devices and their interest in purchasing them.
ex.t: 在Martin的研究中，她让参与者对一款名为“Miuu”的数字语音助手和自动驾驶汽车的有性别、女性、无性别版本评价自己的依恋程度。研究发现，性别增强了用户对这些设备的依恋感以及购买兴趣。

ex.s: Martin’s study also found that creating a genderless object was difficult.
ex.t: Martin的研究还发现，创造一个无性别物体是困难的。

ex.s: The following day, called to the headmaster’s office, I found myself accused of stealing the missing parts.
ex.t: 第二天，我被叫到校长办公室，发现自己被指控偷了那些丢失的零件。

ex.s: He tried muscle-relaxing drugs but found little relief.
ex.t: 他试过肌肉松弛药物，但几乎没有什么缓解。

ex.s: He found there were excellent free books.
ex.t: 他发现那里有很棒的免费书。

ex.s: A survey found that 29 percent of college students registered for online courses.
ex.t: 一项调查发现，29%的大学生注册了在线课程。

ex.s: I also found sentences underlined.
ex.t: 我还发现有句子被划了线。

ex.s: New evidence should be found to back up research findings.
ex.t: 应当找到新的证据来支撑研究成果。

ex.s: I found it difficult, but still hoped to pass.
ex.t: 我觉得很难，但仍希望能通过。

ex.s: By learning when to ask for help, I eventually found myself on the way to becoming an independent scientist.
ex.t: 通过学习何时寻求帮助，我最终走上了成为独立科学家的道路。

ex.s: Past research has found health and wellness benefits of nature for humans, but a new study shows that wildness in urban areas is extremely important for human well-being.
ex.t: 过去的研究发现了大自然对人类健康和幸福的益处，而一项新研究表明，城市中的自然野趣对人类的幸福极其重要。

ex.s: After we found a crazy-looking road that hung over a bunch of rocks, we decided to photograph the scene at sunset.
ex.t: 在我们发现一条悬在一堆岩石上方、看起来奇特的路之后，我们决定在日落时拍摄这一场景。

ex.s: Once we found the place, it was stressful getting lights and cameras set up in the limited time.
ex.t: 一旦我们找到那个地方，在有限的时间里安装灯光和摄像头 压力很大。

ex.s: I’ve always found cold water thrilling.
ex.t: 我一直觉得冷水刺激令人兴奋。

ex.s: I’ve found myself wondering how we gain pleasure from art.
ex.t: 我发现自己好奇我们从艺术中获得愉悦的方式。

ex.s: Research has found that learning obtained from a well-told story is remembered more accurately, and for far longer, than from facts and figures.
ex.t: 研究发现，从一个讲述精彩的故事中学到的东西，比从事实和数据中学到的记得更准确，也持久得多。

ex.s: I found myself working with a robotics professor on techniques for collecting data from the desert remotely.
ex.t: 我发现自己正与一位机器人学教授合作，研究从沙漠远程收集数据的技术。

ex.s: When I applied to graduate school, I found three programmes promising to allow me to follow my desired research direction.
ex.t: 当我申请研究生院时，我发现有三个项目承诺允许我按照自己期望的研究方向发展。

ex.s: A ground-breaking, five-year study shows that diet-related changes in human bite led to new speech sounds that are now found in half the world’s languages.
ex.t: 一项开创性的五年研究表明，与人类咬合相关的饮食变化导致了新的语音，如今这些语音存在于世界上一半的语言中。

ex.s: These sounds are still not found in the languages of many hunter-gatherer people today.
ex.t: 这些声音在今天许多狩猎采集民族的语言中仍然不存在。

ex.s: New researchers found that middle-aged women who were physically fit could be nearly 90 percent less likely to develop dementia in later life, and as they did, it came on a decade later than less sporty women.
ex.t: 新研究发现，身体健硕的中年女性晚年患痴呆症的可能性低近90%，而且即使患病，也比不爱运动的女性晚十年发作。

ex.s: I thought that we would just be passing out dinners to those in need, but I found out we would be doing everything from preparing to serving the dinner.
ex.t: 我以为我们只是分发晚餐给那些需要帮助的人，但我发现我们要做的事情从准备到服务晚餐无所不包。

ex.s: She smiled at me and said if I needed help, she’d be right there, which I found quite comforting.
ex.t: 她对我微笑说如果需要帮助她就在那里，我觉得这很令人安慰。

ex.s: The question,“What do elephants and fish have in common?" may sound strange but researchers have found that they both have a feature not observed in any other creature.
ex.t: "大象和鱼有什么共同点？"这个问题听起来可能很奇怪，但研究人员发现它们都有一个在其他生物身上没有观察到的特征。

ex.s: Where can the text be found?
ex.t: 这篇文章可以在哪里找到？

ex.s: When I returned to London in 2004, I found myself wandering down to Southbank, spending hours there.
ex.t: 2004年回到伦敦时，我发现自己在南岸闲逛，在那里度过几个小时。

ex.s: Indeed, the researchers found that face-to-face interactions and conversations affect the creative process, and yet a coworking space or a coffee shop provides a certain level of noise while also providing freedom from interruptions.
ex.t: 的确，研究人员发现面对面互动和对话会影响创造过程，而联合办公空间或咖啡店提供一定程度的噪音，同时也提供不受打扰的自由。

ex.s: After letting go of his anger and frustration, he found himself on a road to sympathy 18   .
ex.t: 放下愤怒与沮丧后，他发现自己走上了通往同情的18___。

ex.s: But when he went bike shopping, he found few available, which got him thinking: What if the 20  of bikes was Covid-19 related, and what if the person who'd taken his bike really needed 21    to get to work?
ex.t: 但当他去买自行车时发现几乎没有可买的车这让他思考：如果自行车的   20   缺乏与新冠疫情有关呢如果拿走他车的人真的需要   21    去上班呢？

ex.s: A survey of scientists found that extreme weather events, food insecurity, and freshwater shortages might create global collapse.
ex.t: 一项针对科学家的调查发现，极端天气事件、粮食不安全和淡水短缺可能引发全球崩溃。

ex.s: About 480 varieties of trees may be found in just one hectare of rainforest
ex.t: 仅一公顷雨林中就可能有约480种树木。

ex.s: Recent studies have found positive effects.
ex.t: 最近的研究发现了积极的效果。

ex.s: Strano’s team found that they could create a faint light for three-and-a-half hours.
ex.t: 斯特拉诺的团队发现，他们能让植物发出微弱的光达三个半小时。

ex.s: Psychologist Susan Levine, an expert on mathematics development in young children the University of Chicago, found children who play with puzzles between ages 2 and 4 later develop better spatial skills.
ex.t: 芝加哥大学儿童数学发展专家、心理学家苏珊·莱文发现，在2到4岁之间玩拼图的孩子，日后会发展出更好的空间技能。

ex.s: The researchers analyzed video recordings of 53 child-parent pairs during everyday activities at home and found children who play with puzzles between 26 and 46 months of age have better spatial skills when assessed at 54 months of age.
ex.t: 研究者分析了53对亲子在家日常活动中的录像，发现26至46个月大时玩拼图的孩子，在54个月大评估时空间技能更好。

ex.s: As Inglis and, later other businessmen, got to work, repurposed phone boxes began reappearing in cities and villages as people found new uses for them.
ex.t: 随着英格利斯以及后来的其他商人开始行动，被重新利用的电话亭重新出现在城乡各地，因为人们为它们找到了新用途。

ex.s: The tiny shops made economic sense, according to Robert Kerr, a founder of LoveFone.
ex.t: 据LoveFone创始人罗伯特·克尔说，这些小店在经济上是行得通的。

ex.s: But it was the effects deep within the fat cells that may have been the most significant, the researchers found.
ex.t: 但研究人员发现，脂肪细胞深处的影响可能是最显著的。

ex.s: We have looked at our planet from every angle and found all of the wildest things left to find.
ex.t: 我们从各个角度观察了我们的星球，找到了所有最狂野的待发现之物。

ex.s: I began a second drawer for more general discoveries: new cave system discovered with dozens of nameless species, four hundred species of bacteria found in the human stomach.
ex.t: 我开始了第二个抽屉，用来放更一般的发现：被发现的有几十种无名物种的新洞穴系统、在人体胃部发现的四百种细菌。

ex.s: In looking for the stories of discovery, I found the stories of these people and how their lives changed our view of the world.
ex.t: 在寻找发现的故事时，我找到了这些人的故事，以及他们的生活如何改变了我们的世界观。

ex.s: We are repeatedly willing to imagine we have found most of what is left to discover.
ex.t: 我们总是一厢情愿地以为，所剩待发现的东西大都已经被我们找到。

ex.s: He's not ready to retire, but he's found a new hobby to keep his hands skillful in the years to come.
ex.t: 他还没准备退休，但已找到一项新爱好，让他的双手在未来岁月里保持灵巧。

ex.s: Just a few days after the signs went up, he found people sitting there and engaging in active and   28   conversations.
ex.t: 牌子挂上才几天，他就发现人们坐在那里，进行着活跃而___28___的交谈。

ex.s: He got up and shook Vinnie's hand warmly, “I've heard that you are a talented young woman, and I have found you charming and intelligent as well.
ex.t: 他起身热情地握住温妮的手：“我听说你是一位有天赋的年轻女子，而且我也发现你既迷人又聪明。”

ex.s: They rose in the ranks not by being friendly but by smoking cigarettes, breaking rules and playing jokes on others, among whom I soon found myself.
ex.t: 他们在队伍中的崛起不是因为友好，而是因为抽烟、违反规则和取笑别人，我很快就发现自己就在别人中间。

ex.s: “We found that the least well-liked teens had become more aggressive over time toward their classmates.
ex.t: "我们发现最不受欢迎的青少年随着时间的推移变得越来越具有攻击性。

ex.s: Does Kilimanjaro   60   its reputation as a crowded mountain with lines of tourists ruining the atmosphere of peace？I found the opposite to be true.
ex.t: 乞力马扎罗山___60___它作为一座拥挤、游客排成长队破坏宁静氛围的山之名声了吗？我发现事实恰恰相反。

ex.s: The polar bear is found in the Arctic Circle and some big land masses as far south as Newfoundland.
ex.t: 北极熊生活在北极圈内和一些向南远至纽芬兰的大型陆地上。

ex.s: A new report found 46 percent of meals are eaten alone in America.
ex.t: 一份新报告发现，美国有46%的餐食是独自吃的。

ex.s: Piccoli, found in an antique shop.
ex.t: 皮科利，在一家古董店发现的。

ex.s: We're taught to read because it's necessary for much of human understanding． Reading is a vital part of my life． Reading satisfies my desire to keep learning． And I've found that the possibilities that lie within books are limitless．
ex.t: 我们被教导阅读，因为这对于人类理解的许多内容来说是必要的。阅读是我生活中不可或缺的一部分。阅读满足了我不断学习的渴望。而且我发现，书中蕴含的可能性是无限的。

ex.s: （2）A strong link is found between two species when a predator     ．
ex.t: （2）当捕食者___时，两个物种间会发现强联系。

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.s: Although she founded her company early on in life, she wasn't driven primarily by profit.
ex.t: 尽管她早年就创办了公司，但她主要的驱动力并非利润。

ex.s: In a world that warms up by 3℃，it found that multiple changes to the colour of the oceans would occur.
ex.t: 在一个升温3摄氏度的世界中，研究发现海洋的颜色将发生多种变化。

ex.s: They found that more on-demand entertainment viewing on tablets instead of TVs and desktop computers could cut energy consumption by 44%.
ex.t: 他们发现，更多在平板电脑上而不是电视和台式电脑上进行按需娱乐观看可以将能耗降低44%。

ex.s: ●   39   Studies found that people who woke up early for exercise slept better than those who exercised in the evening.
ex.t: ● ____39____研究发现早起锻炼的人比晚上锻炼的人睡得更好。

ex.s: But soon, the gold that Dawson depended on had all been found.
ex.t: 但很快，道森所依赖的黄金全部被找到了。

ex.s: They found the city too crowded.
ex.t: 他们觉得这座城市太拥挤。

ex.s: I found the pre-holidays a good time to encourage young children to donate less-used things, and it worked.
ex.t: 我发现节前是鼓励小孩子捐赠不太用得上的东西的好时机，而且这招很管用。

ex.s: One study found that a cotton bag must be used at least 131 times to be better for the planet than plastic.
ex.t: 一项研究发现，一个棉布袋必须至少使用131次，才比塑料袋对环境更有利。

ex.s: I suddenly found myself out of class before noon time.
ex.t: 然后我到了不得不熬到深夜才能独自完成作业的地步。

ex.s: Researchers have found that there is a direct link between the increase in food eaten outside the home and the rise in   64  (weigh) problems.
ex.t: 研究人员发现，在家外就餐的增加与___64___（weigh）问题的上升之间有直接联系。

ex.s: While 78 percent of parents said they believed they were good screen time role models, the study found a disconnect between their behavior and their perception of their behavior.
ex.t: 虽然78%的父母说他们相信自己是有良好屏幕时间榜样的人，但研究发现他们的行为与他们对自身行为的认知之间存在脱节。

ex.s: Researchers in Spain and England recently found that the worms of the greater wax moth can break down polyethylene, which accounts for 40% of plastics.
ex.t: 西班牙和英格兰的研究者最近发现，大蜡螟的幼虫能分解占塑料40%的聚乙烯。

ex.s: A wire basket was found.
ex.t: 找到一个铁丝篮。

ex.s: One of the most famous theatres in Georgia, the Marjanishvili, founded in 1928, appears regularly at theatre festivals all over the world.
ex.t: 马尔贾尼什维利剧院是格鲁吉亚最著名的剧院之一，成立于1928年，经常在世界各地的戏剧节上演出。

ex.s: The Habima is the centre of Hebrew-language theatre worldwide, Founded in Moscow after the 1905 revolution, the company eventually settled in Tel Aviv in the late 1920s.
ex.t: 哈比马是全球希伯来语戏剧的中心，成立于1905年革命后的莫斯科，该公司于20世纪20年代末最终定居特拉维夫。

ex.s: Scientists have found that all kinds of plants give out VOCs when being attacked.
ex.t: 科学家发现，各种植物在受到攻击时都会释放VOCs。

ex.s: The theater owner found it suitable.
ex.t: 剧院老板觉得合适。

ex.s: “For example, most of us would expect older drivers always go slower than everyone else but surprisingly, we found that in 30mph zones they struggled to keep at a constant speed and so were more likely to break the speed limit and be at risk of getting fined.
ex.t: “例如，我们大多数人都以为老年驾驶者总是比其他人开得慢，但令人惊讶的是，我们发现，在限速30英里每小时的区域，他们难以保持匀速，因此更有可能超速并被罚款的风险。

ex.s: He found out his can of hear spray.
ex.t: 他找到了他的防熊喷雾罐。

ex.s: What they found was that people wearing white coats performed better than those who weren’t.
ex.t: 人们的穿着会影响他们的感受

ex.t: 马尔贾尼什维利剧院是格鲁吉亚最著名的剧院之一，成立于1928年，经常在世界各地的戏剧节上演出。

ex.s: Female Australian superb fairy wrens were found to repeat one sound over and over again while hatching their eggs.
ex.t: 人们发现，雌性澳大利亚壮丽细尾鹩莺在孵蛋时会一遍又一遍地重复同一个声音。

ex.s: The teacher found I was struggling with note-taking and told me to stop and just listen.
ex.t: 老师发现我在记笔记方面有困难，就告诉我停下来只听讲。

ex.s: When I got the paper back, I found my teacher had written the comment "Not bad!" Not bad?
ex.t: 当我拿回试卷时，我发现老师写了评语“不错！”不错？

ex.s: Grandfather: Yes, and you have found the career that suits your talents.
ex.t: 祖父：是的，而且你已经找到了适合你才华的事业。

ex.s: Sunday 20 October I was tidying my room yesterday and found an old photo in a notebook.
ex.t: 10月20日星期天：昨天我在收拾房间时，在一个笔记本里发现了一张旧照片。

ex.s: A team of scientists led by Professor Eli Shlizerman at the University of Washington has now found the answer.
ex.t: 华盛顿大学的Eli Shlizerman教授领导的一个科学家小组现在已经找到了答案。

ex.s: She drove on for a while and found herself on an unfamiliar road toward a Canadian town.
ex.t: 她又开了一会儿，发现自己走上了一条通往加拿大小镇的陌生道路。

ex.s: Having a poor sense of direction, Eva found it impossible to get around in such a huge building.

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
ex.t: 每个人都是这样学会阅读的。我们从句子开始，然后是段落，再然后是故事。这似乎是一段永无止境的旅程，但即使作为一个六岁的女孩，我也意识到学会阅读能打开许多扇门。当妈妈说：“C-A-N-D-Y藏在最上面的架子上”时，我知道糖果在哪里。我在阅读上的进步激发了我的好奇心，我想知道一切。我经常叫妈妈开慢一点，这样我就能读出我们路过的所有路标。
